notes.title: Lunar New Year Update!
notes.notes:
Happy Lunar New Year everyone!!!!

This update brings you 2 new girls(Lunar & Eclipse) and with 2 new girls comes 4 new levels!

We have also fixed many Post Processing effects so the game should overall look better.

Remember that Hentai Dreams will be 50% off starting Tomorrow!!!

notes.title: 3D Escape Game Update!
notes.notes:
We have updated the camera position on the 3D Escape Game and lowered the colliding box so that it will be easier to complete the puzzles.

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Puzzle Maker / Girl - Update
notes.notes:
In this update we have released our new XMAS girl called Crystal. We have also launched our new Puzzle Maker that will allow users to load in there own image and play it. Please make sure to read the README inside the games main folder to see how you can load your own girls into the game!

Patch Notes:
Added - 1 new girl
Added - Puzzle Maker
